title: Effect of disruption in intestinal barrier function during transgenerational process on nanoplastic toxicity induction in Caenorhabditis elegans
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00149H, Paper
Yuxing Wang, Dayong Wang
After exposure at parental generation (P0-G), nanoplastics can induce transgenerational toxicity. Nevertheless, it remains unclear whether change in intestinal barrier function during transgenerational process affects the induction of nanoplastic toxicity....
